doc.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018

title: Keeping his voice healthy
summary: He drinks water, Jessie got him to cut down smoking, and he jokes about quitting.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Do you have to do anything to try to keep your voice healthy?

I drink loads of water. Apart from that nothing, no. I used to warm up, but only when my voice was already suffering. It’s like shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted really, but Jessie got me to drink loads of water which helped a lot. And she persuaded me, almost persuaded me to cut down smoking which I’m down to eighty a day now.
Well if I saw you in a year you could say, “I’ve quit four times already.”
Which I know exactly. I did tell of, it takes a lot of willpower to quit that many times.
